articles.title: Google co-founder Larry Page leaves California ahead of billionaire tax vote
articles.summary: As Californians gear up to cast their votes on Proposition 40, which suggests a one-time tax on billionaires, notable figures like Larry Page have relocated their businesses far from the state's reach to evade this tax burden. While the tax could potentially rake in $100 billion, the exodus of these wealthy individuals—who would collectively owe around $29 billion—poses a serious threat to California's expected income from this tax initiative..

articles.title: Emma Stone’s 1926 LA home sells for $4.3 million after renovation, $305,000 above asking price
articles.summary: Emma Stone has beautifully transformed a historic home in Los Angeles, which she bought for $2.3 million back in 2019. After completing significant renovations, she listed the property for $3.995 million in January 2024.

articles.title: J&K government doubles monthly stipend for MBBS, BDS interns to Rs 25,000 after renewed protests over delayed hike
articles.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir government has increased the monthly stipend for MBBS and BDS interns, including Foreign Medical Graduates (FMGs), from Rs 12,300 to Rs 25,000, effective October 1, 2026. The decision follows renewed protests by interns over delays in fulfilling an earlier assurance.

articles.title: Big Tech in classrooms: Why parents should question Silicon Valley’s growing influence on education
articles.summary: As technology companies expand their presence in classrooms, concerns are growing over their influence on curricula, teaching practices and student data. Drawing on technology reporter Natasha Singer’s book Coding Kids, the article examines how companies shape digital education and questions whether devices alone improve learning outcomes.

articles.title: Punjab & Sind Bank LBO result 2026 declared; 587 candidates shortlisted for language test and document verification: Check details here
articles.summary: Punjab & Sind Bank has announced the Phase III result for Local Bank Officer (LBO) Recruitment 2026, shortlisting 587 candidates provisionally for the next stage. Candidates can access the result PDF online using their roll numbers.

articles.title: 'Dragon' actor Khushbu Sundar speaks out against cyberattacks
articles.summary: Khushbu has publicly denounced the cyberattacks and personal harassment aimed at celebrities, firmly stating that their status doesn't excuse harassment towards them or their families. After her X account was compromised, she urged her followers to stay alert for any unusual activity and to report it.

articles.title: Vishwak Sen takes charge of ‘Cult’ after ‘Laila’ failure
articles.summary: Vishwak Sen boldly steps into the director's chair with his new film 'Cult' following a series of setbacks. Taking full ownership of the project, he aims to create a unique cinematic experience featuring a remarkable ensemble of about 150 actors.

articles.title: Amitabh Bachchan reveals how he manages household chores
articles.summary: Amitabh Bachchan revealed his approach to household chores when domestic help is absent, handling cleaning himself while relying on Jaya Bachchan for cooking. He mentioned his preference for ordering food, noting that Jaya enjoys preparing dishes upon his request.

articles.title: 'Clayface' hailed as best villain origin story since ‘The Joker’
